Released on 10 June 1980, the album is one of Marley's most directly religious, with nearly every song referencing his religious beliefs, culminating in the acoustic recording of \"Redemption Song\".\nUprising peaked at number 41 on the US Billboard Black Albums chart, and number 45 on the Pop Albums chart. \"Could You Be Loved\" was number six and number 56 respectively on the Club Play Singles and Black Singles charts.
